question_en: A wire is stretched so that its length increases by a factor of $2$ at constant volume. By what factor does its resistance increase?
question_uz: Sim hajmi o'zgarmagan holda uzunligi $2$ marta oshiriladigan qilib cho'zildi. Qarshiligi necha marta ortadi?
question_ru: Провод растянули так, что его длина увеличилась в $2$ раза при неизменном объёме. Во сколько раз возросло его сопротивление?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Hajm o'zgarmas: L ikki marta ortsa, kesim ikki marta kamayadi; R = ρL/A — 4 marta.
Asos: qarshilik formulasi.

distractors.D: kesim to'rt marta kamayadi deb olingan
distractors.E: L va A ikkalasi kvadratga ko'tarilgan

distractors_ru.E: L и A возведены в квадрат

distractors_en.A: the change in cross-section was ignored
distractors_en.D: the area was taken as four times smaller
distractors_en.E: both L and A were squared

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 9.31-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The same current flows in two wires of the same material; the second has a diameter $2$ times smaller than the first. By what factor is the drift speed larger in the second wire?
question_uz: Bir xil materialdan yasalgan ikki simdan bir xil tok o'tmoqda; ikkinchisining diametri birinchisinikidan $2$ marta kichik. Ikkinchi simda tartibli harakat tezligi necha marta katta?
question_ru: По двум проводам из одного материала течёт одинаковый ток; диаметр второго в $2$ раза меньше, чем первого. Во сколько раз скорость дрейфа во втором проводе больше?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. v = I/(neA), A ∝ d²: diametr ikki marta kamaysa, kesim 4 marta kamayadi, tezlik 4 marta ortadi.
Asos: tok zichligi.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 9.17-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: In the Drude model the electron density is $n$, mass $m$, charge $e$ and mean free time $\tau_0$. What is the conductivity?
question_uz: Drude modelida elektronlar konsentratsiyasi $n$, massasi $m$, zaryadi $e$, o'rtacha erkin yugurish vaqti $\tau_0$. Solishtirma o'tkazuvchanlik nimaga teng?
question_ru: В модели Друде концентрация электронов $n$, масса $m$, заряд $e$, среднее время свободного пробега $\tau_0$. Чему равна удельная проводимость?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. v = eEτ₀/m, J = nev = (ne²τ₀/m)E — demak σ = ne²τ₀/m.
Asos: Drude modeli.

uz: Tartibli harakat tezligi va tok zichligi: $$J=ne\cdot\frac{eE\tau_0}{m}\ \Rightarrow\ \sigma=\frac{ne^2\tau_0}{m}$$

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», Drude modeli g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A $2\ \Omega$ resistor is connected to a source with EMF $6\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $1\ \Omega$. What is the terminal voltage, in volts?
question_uz: EYK $6\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $1\ \Omega$ bo'lgan manbaga $2\ \Omega$ rezistor ulangan. Qisqichlardagi kuchlanish necha volt?
question_ru: К источнику с ЭДС $6\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $1\ \Omega$ подключён резистор $2\ \Omega$. Сколько вольт на зажимах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. I = 6/(2 + 1) = 2 A, U = E − Ir = 6 − 2 = 4 V (yoki IR = 4 V).
Asos: to'liq zanjir uchun Om qonuni.

distractors_en.B: the voltage across the internal resistance
distractors_en.E: the current was taken as 1 A

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 10.15-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: What is the largest power, in watts, that a source with EMF $10\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $5\ \Omega$ can deliver to an external load?
question_uz: EYK $10\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $5\ \Omega$ bo'lgan manbadan tashqi yukka berilishi mumkin bo'lgan eng katta quvvat necha vatt?
question_ru: Какую наибольшую мощность (в ваттах) можно передать во внешнюю нагрузку от источника с ЭДС $10\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $5\ \Omega$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. R = r = 5 Ω da: I = 1 A, P = I²R = 5 W = E²/(4r).
Asos: eng katta foydali quvvat.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 10.21-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: What is the resistance between opposite corners of a cube each of whose edges is a resistor $R$?
question_uz: Har bir qirrasi $R$ qarshilikli rezistor bo'lgan kubning qarama-qarshi uchlari orasidagi qarshilik qancha?
question_ru: Каково сопротивление между противоположными вершинами куба, каждое ребро которого — резистор $R$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Simmetriya: tok 3, 6, 3 qirraga teng bo'linadi: U = IR/3 + IR/6 + IR/3 = 5IR/6.
Asos: simmetriya.

rules.uz: Simmetriya: teng potensialli nuqtalar orasida tok yo'q
rules.ru: Симметрия: между точками равного потенциала тока нет
rules.en: Symmetry: no current between points of equal potential

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», kub g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Each section of an infinite ladder has one series $R$ in the top rail, one in the bottom rail and one $R$ between them. What is the input resistance?
question_uz: Cheksiz zanjirning har bir bo'g'inida yuqori va pastki simlarda bittadan ketma-ket $R$ va ular orasida bitta $R$ bor. Kirish qarshiligi qancha?
question_ru: В каждом звене бесконечной цепочки по одному последовательному $R$ в верхнем и нижнем проводах и один $R$ между ними. Каково входное сопротивление?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Rx = 2R + R·Rx/(R + Rx) → Rx² − 2R·Rx − 2R² = 0 → Rx = (1 + √3)R.
Asos: cheksiz zanjir.

rules.uz: Cheksiz zanjir: bir bo'g'inni olib tashlash $R$ ni o'zgartirmaydi
rules.ru: Бесконечная цепь: удаление звена не меняет $R$
rules.en: Infinite ladder: removing one section does not change $R$

distractors_en.E: the resistance of a single section

source: original (B2-L15, cheksiz zanjir)

question_en: In an $RC$ circuit a capacitor discharges through the resistor. How long does it take for the voltage to halve?
question_uz: $RC$ zanjirda kondensator rezistor orqali zaryadsizlanmoqda. Kuchlanish necha vaqtda yarmiga tushadi?
question_ru: В $RC$-цепи конденсатор разряжается через резистор. За какое время напряжение уменьшится вдвое?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. U = U₀·exp(−t/RC) = U₀/2 → t = RC·ln 2 ≈ 0.69RC.
Asos: RC zaryadsizlanish.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 10.75-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: An uncharged capacitor $C$ is fully charged from an ideal source of EMF $\mathcal{E}$ through a resistor $R$. How much heat is released in the resistor?
question_uz: Zaryadsiz $C$ kondensator EYK $\mathcal{E}$ bo'lgan ideal manbadan $R$ rezistor orqali to'liq zaryadlandi. Rezistorda qancha issiqlik ajraladi?
question_ru: Незаряженный конденсатор $C$ полностью заряжен от идеального источника с ЭДС $\mathcal{E}$ через резистор $R$. Сколько тепла выделилось в резисторе?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Manba CE² ish bajaradi, kondensatorga CE²/2 o'tadi, qolgan CE²/2 — issiqlik, R ga bog'liq emas.
Asos: energiya balansi.

distractors.B: ideal manbada isrof yo'q deb o'ylangan

source: original (B2-L15, energiya balansi)

question_en: A source $\mathcal{E}$ feeds $R_1$ in series, followed by an uncharged capacitor $C$ in parallel with $R_2$. What is the current in $R_1$ immediately after the switch closes?
question_uz: $\mathcal{E}$ manbaga ketma-ket $R_1$, so'ng parallel ulangan zaryadsiz kondensator $C$ va $R_2$ ulangan. Kalit ulangan ondan keyin $R_1$ dagi tok qancha?
question_ru: К источнику $\mathcal{E}$ подключены последовательно $R_1$ и затем параллельно соединённые незаряженный конденсатор $C$ и $R_2$. Каков ток через $R_1$ сразу после замыкания ключа?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. t = 0⁺ da zaryadsiz kondensator kuchlanishi nol — u R₂ ni qisqa tutashtiradi: I = E/R₁.
Asos: RC chegaraviy holatlari.

en: The capacitor acts as a wire: $$U_C(0)=0\ \Rightarrow\ I_1=\frac{\mathcal{E}}{R_1}$$

distractors_ru.C: считается, что конденсатор не пропускает ток

distractors_en.D: mixed up with a current-divider formula

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», RC chegaraviy holatlari g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: In the circuit of the previous question, what is the capacitor voltage after a long time?
question_uz: Oldingi savoldagi zanjirda ko'p vaqt o'tgach kondensatordagi kuchlanish qancha bo'ladi?
question_ru: Каким станет напряжение на конденсаторе в цепи предыдущего вопроса спустя долгое время?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. t → ∞ da kondensator orqali tok yo'q; R₁ va R₂ kuchlanish bo'lgichi: U = E·R₂/(R₁ + R₂).
Asos: RC chegaraviy holatlari.

en: The capacitor is a break; a voltage divider: $$U_C=\frac{\mathcal{E}R_2}{R_1+R_2}$$

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», RC chegaraviy holatlari g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: What is the charging time constant of the capacitor in the circuit of the previous question?
question_uz: Oldingi savoldagi zanjirda kondensator zaryadlanishining vaqt doimiysi qancha?
question_ru: Какова постоянная времени зарядки конденсатора в цепи предыдущего вопроса?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Kondensatordan qaraganda manba o'chirilsa, R₁ va R₂ parallel: r₀ = R₁R₂/(R₁ + R₂), τ = r₀C.
Asos: ekvivalent manba.

distractors_en.D: the resistors were taken in series

source: original (B2-L15, vaqt doimiysi)

question_en: The figure shows the current $I(t)$ as a capacitor discharges through $R=1\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$. What is the capacitance?
question_uz: Rasmda $R=1\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ orqali zaryadsizlanayotgan kondensator tokining $I(t)$ grafigi berilgan. Kondensator sig'imi qancha?
question_ru: На рисунке дан график тока $I(t)$ при разрядке конденсатора через $R=1\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$. Какова ёмкость конденсатора?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Tok 10 mA dan 3.68 mA ga (e marta) 2 ms da tushadi: τ = 2 ms, C = τ/R = 2 μF.
Asos: RC zaryadsizlanish.

en: The time for the current to fall by $e$: $$\tau=2\ \mathrm{ms},\quad C=\frac{\tau}{R}=\frac{2\cdot10^{-3}}{10^3}=2\ \mu\mathrm{F}$$

distractors.B: yarmiga tushish vaqti τ deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: время уменьшения вдвое принято за τ

distractors_en.B: the halving time was taken as τ

source: original (B2-L15, I(t) grafigi)

question_en: Excess charge is placed inside a conductor of conductivity $\sigma$. With what time constant does it disappear ($\varepsilon=1$)?
question_uz: Solishtirma o'tkazuvchanligi $\sigma$ bo'lgan o'tkazgich ichiga ortiqcha zaryad kiritildi. Zaryad qanday vaqt doimiysi bilan yo'qoladi ($\varepsilon=1$)?
question_ru: Внутрь проводника с удельной проводимостью $\sigma$ внесли избыточный заряд. С какой постоянной времени он исчезает ($\varepsilon=1$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Uzluksizlik + Gauss + J = σE: dρ/dt = −(σ/ε₀)ρ, τ = ε₀/σ.
Asos: zaryad relaksatsiyasi.
source: original (B2-L15, zaryad relaksatsiyasi)

question_en: The space between two concentric metal spheres of radii $a<b$ is filled with a material of resistivity $\rho$. What is the resistance between the spheres?
question_uz: Radiuslari $a<b$ bo'lgan ikki konsentrik metall sfera orasi solishtirma qarshiligi $\rho$ bo'lgan modda bilan to'ldirilgan. Sferalar orasidagi qarshilik qancha?
question_ru: Пространство между двумя концентрическими металлическими сферами радиусов $a<b$ заполнено веществом с удельным сопротивлением $\rho$. Каково сопротивление между сферами?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Sferik qatlamlar ketma-ket: R = ∫ρdr/(4πr²) = (ρ/4π)(1/a − 1/b) = ρ(b − a)/(4πab).
Asos: qatlamlar ketma-ket.
source: original (B2-L15, sferik qatlam)

question_en: Two batteries with EMFs $12\ \mathrm{V}$ and $6\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistances of $1\ \Omega$ each are connected in parallel, like terminals together, with no external load. What current (in A) circulates through them?
question_uz: EYK lari $12\ \mathrm{V}$ va $6\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiliklari $1\ \Omega$ dan bo'lgan ikki akkumulyator bir xil qutblari bilan parallel ulangan, tashqi yuk yo'q. Ular orqali qancha tok aylanadi (A)?
question_ru: Два аккумулятора с ЭДС $12\ \mathrm{V}$ и $6\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренними сопротивлениями по $1\ \Omega$ соединены параллельно одноимёнными полюсами, внешней нагрузки нет. Какой ток (в A) циркулирует через них?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Kontur: 12 − 6 = I(1 + 1) → I = 3 A; kuchsiz akkumulyator zaryadlanadi.
Asos: kontur qoidasi.

distractors.A: EYK lar qo'shilgan va ikkiga bo'lingan
distractors.D: parallel manbalarda tok yo'q deb o'ylangan

distractors_en.A: the EMFs were added and halved

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 10.57-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Bulbs rated $60\ \mathrm{W}$ and $100\ \mathrm{W}$ at $120\ \mathrm{V}$ are connected in series across a $120\ \mathrm{V}$ supply. What power (in W) does the $60\ \mathrm{W}$ bulb receive? Which bulb is brighter?
question_uz: $120\ \mathrm{V}$ ga mo'ljallangan $60\ \mathrm{W}$ va $100\ \mathrm{W}$ lampalar ketma-ket ulanib, $120\ \mathrm{V}$ tarmoqqa ulandi. $60\ \mathrm{W}$ lampa qancha quvvat oladi (W)? Qaysi lampa yorug'roq?
question_ru: Лампы $60\ \mathrm{W}$ и $100\ \mathrm{W}$, рассчитанные на $120\ \mathrm{V}$, соединили последовательно и включили в сеть $120\ \mathrm{V}$. Какую мощность (в W) получает лампа $60\ \mathrm{W}$? Какая лампа ярче?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. R₆₀ = 240 Ω, R₁₀₀ = 144 Ω; I = 120/384 A; P₆₀ = I²·240 ≈ 23.4 W — 60 W lampa yorug'roq.
Asos: ketma-ket ulash.
source: original (B2-L15, ketma-ket lampalar)

question_en: Two $10\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ resistors in series are connected to an ideal $12\ \mathrm{V}$ source. A voltmeter of resistance $10\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ is connected across one of them. What does it read, in volts?
question_uz: $10\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ li ikki rezistor ketma-ket ulanib, $12\ \mathrm{V}$ ideal manbaga ulangan. Ulardan biriga qarshiligi $10\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ bo'lgan voltmetr ulandi. Voltmetr necha volt ko'rsatadi?
question_ru: Два резистора по $10\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$ соединены последовательно и подключены к идеальному источнику $12\ \mathrm{V}$. К одному из них подключили вольтметр с сопротивлением $10\ \mathrm{k}\Omega$. Сколько вольт он покажет?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Voltmetr va rezistor parallel: 5 kΩ; bo'lgich: U = 12·5/(10 + 5) = 4 V (ideal holatda 6 V).
Asos: asbob zanjirga ta'sir qiladi.

en: The parallel part and the divider: $$R'=5\ \mathrm{k}\Omega,\quad U=12\cdot\frac{5}{10+5}=4\ \mathrm{V}$$

distractors_en.D: the voltage on the other resistor

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 10.85-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A copper wire has resistance $R_0$ at $0^\circ\mathrm{C}$ and temperature coefficient $4\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$. What is its resistance at $100^\circ\mathrm{C}$ (as a multiple of $R_0$)?
question_uz: Mis simning $0^\circ\mathrm{C}$ dagi qarshiligi $R_0$, temperatura koeffitsiyenti $4\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$. $100^\circ\mathrm{C}$ da qarshilik qancha (ifoda $R_0$ ga ko'paytuvchi)?
question_ru: Сопротивление медного провода при $0^\circ\mathrm{C}$ равно $R_0$, температурный коэффициент $4\cdot10^{-3}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$. Каково сопротивление при $100^\circ\mathrm{C}$ (множитель при $R_0$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. R = R₀(1 + αΔT) = R₀(1 + 0.004·100) = 1.4R₀ — metall qarshiligi temperatura bilan ortadi.
Asos: temperaturaga bog'liqlik.

distractors_ru.E: без единицы и в 10 раз больше

distractors_en.C: wrong sign, as for a semiconductor
distractors_en.E: missing the 1 and ten times too large

source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 9.49-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A current of $1\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in a copper wire of cross-section $1\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ ($n\approx10^{29}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$). The electrons' drift speed is roughly $10^k\ \mathrm{m/s}$; what is $k$?
question_uz: Kesimi $1\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ bo'lgan mis simdan ($n\approx10^{29}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$) $1\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Elektronlarning tartibli harakat tezligi taxminan $10^k\ \mathrm{m/s}$; $k$ nimaga teng?
question_ru: По медному проводу сечением $1\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ ($n\approx10^{29}\ \mathrm{m^{-3}}$) течёт ток $1\ \mathrm{A}$. Скорость дрейфа электронов примерно $10^k\ \mathrm{m/s}$; чему равно $k$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. v = I/(neA) = 1/(10²⁹·1.6·10⁻¹⁹·10⁻⁶) ≈ 6·10⁻⁵ ≈ 10⁻⁴ m/s — juda sekin.
Asos: tok zichligi.
source: OpenStax, «University Physics», Vol. 2 (CC BY 4.0), 9.13-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan
